items.title: Blue Origin raises $10B as Bezos’ total investment hits $32B - WSJ
items.summary: Investing.com -- Jeff Bezos is doubling down on his ambitions in the space race. According to details reported by the Wall Street Journal, the Amazon founder has now poured a staggering $32 billion into Blue Origin since its founding in 2000, funding the venture through strategic sell-offs of his Amazon stock.
